column1: # B-band light curves for three nearby Type Ia supernovae spanning stretch.
# Source: Open Supernova Catalog (Guillochon et al. 2017
#   decliner) and SN 2005eq (slow decliner). B band only
#   window of −18 to +55 days from the brightest B point
#   does not drag the film into nebular months.
# time_mjd is the median MJD of the night; days_from_peak is that minus the
#   MJD of the brightest B observation (not a fitted maximum). b_mag_error is
#   the median reported uncertainty that night
# n_obs is how many B points were combined into the night.
